Why_this_title: Early Access Jun 2025 → expanded content Aug → public worldwide-open Dec → corporate global-scale launch Q1 2026 → UA normalization Q2.
What_to_learn: Store product-stage, geography-availability stage and commercial-scale stage separately.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not force a single launch date when first-party sources use different stage definitions.

Why_this_title: Jan-27 creator sponsorship used both a unique reward code and OneLink deep link.
What_to_learn: Every creator/partner campaign should launch with source ID, deep link and redeem code before spend scales.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not infer creator contribution from campaign existence alone.

Why_this_title: Q2 corporate report explicitly attributes margin improvement primarily to normalized UA investment after launch phase.
What_to_learn: Launch plans need a planned scale→normalize gate based on marginal cohort value, not an indefinite launch burn.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not cut UA simply because installs decline; measure D7/D30 value and revenue carryover.

Why_this_title: May→Aug downloads -47.5% while revenue -7.8%; calendar pseudo-ARPI +75.6%.
What_to_learn: Separate acquisition-volume health from installed-base monetization health.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not call calendar pseudo-ARPI LTV or monetization uplift.

Why_this_title: New Moon says BFH shipped in under a year using shared franchise pipelines/lessons; corporate evidence shows staged launch and later UA normalization.
What_to_learn: Build reusable tech/content/measurement packages so product iteration speed and launch operating cadence improve together.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not interpret BIG-franchise 100+ staff as BFH title-team size.
